# Course availability fixtures

Minimized official UW listings downloaded October 20, 2026:

- Catalog: https://www.washington.edu/students/crscat/cse.html
- Quarter offerings: https://www.washington.edu/students/timeschd/pub/AUT2026/cse.html

Only identifying headers and course anchors are retained. The current catalog
includes CSE 112 and excludes CSE 999; the Autumn 2026 offerings do not list CSE 112.
These snapshots test the difference between an unknown code, a known course not
offered in a quarter, and a listed course with an unavailable website.
